data.narrative:
Velaura AI is a Series C semiconductor company founded by Rajiv Khemani, Barun Kar, Saptadeep Pal, and Patrick Xu, having raised $343M to date. The valuation analysis references a comp universe of 3 public semiconductor peers (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private-stage companies, with direct Series B/C/D comparables including d-Matrix ($2.0B Series C), Tenstorrent ($2.7B Series D), Positron AI ($1.0B Series B), and DEEPX ($529M Series C).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, yielding $583M. Peer-median analysis across the 4-company same-sector, same/adjacent-stage cohort generates $1.5B, with a range spanning $529M to $2.7B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to unavailable revenue data for the target.

Triangulation across these two methods produces a valuation range of $496M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $1.0B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty in stage progression assumptions versus market-rate peer valuations. Stage-progression implies more conservative positioning; peer-median reflects heterogeneity in how the market values earlier-stage semiconductor developers. Without revenue visibility or post-Series C fundraising signals, the analysis supports a $1.0B–$1.5B working range, noting particular sensitivity to comparables selection within the volatile frontier-chip sector.
